scope: One prospective injected supervisor boundary draft; no actual Popen, native import, filesystem integration or OS probe in an eventual harness. Harness source is not implemented or executed here.
cases: Preparation at or beyond 15 seconds, stop requested, or remaining local envelope below 35 seconds: target Popen is never reached. Target retains 30 seconds plus 2+2 cleanup; local supervisor envelope is 50 seconds inside caller total 60.

TERM immediately before, during or after Popen: handler only sets a sticky flag; a returned handle and actual wait are retained before fallible bookkeeping; cooperative cleanup reaches the exact direct root.

Clock raises or returns a nonfinite value on cleanup entry or either timeout sample: original cleanup end is never refreshed; actual early and final captured waits are independently attempted with zero timeout when necessary.

Poll/TERM/early-wait/KILL/selector/pipe/log-close errors independently and in combination: final actual captured wait is attempted; every resource close is attempted; unknown remains sticky even after a later successful wait.
Captured final wait times out at zero: rootReaped remains false; no target closure acknowledgement claims certainty. Successful actual wait may record reap, but cannot erase prior unknown.
Read failure on one pipe, ordinary EOF on the other, successful close of both: EOF, streamClosed and per-stream errors remain independent and accurately labelled.
Reaped or mismatched direct handle: no signal or pid adoption; no process group/descendant/global signalling or absence claim.

Known samples immediately before, exactly at, and after the original work end: before is eligible, at/after latches work_deadline. Cleanup entry rechecks the original work end even after ordinary EOF/exit.

Known remaining cleanup time exactly zero or negative: cleanup_deadline is latched independently of ownershipUnknown; actual early and final captured wait(timeout=0) are still invoked and each resource close is attempted.
Late actual wait(timeout=0) succeeds with exit 0 and both pipes close: rootReaped/stdioClosed may truthfully become true, but bounded acceptance remains false; no expiry latch is cleared.
Known final sample at/past the original frozen cleanup end or 50-second supervisor envelope: acceptance is false even when every actual reap/EOF/close fact is true. Ends are never refreshed.

Known exhaustion followed by an earlier recovered clock sample stays failed. A raising/nonfinite clock followed by late exit 0 stays ownershipUnknown and cannot pass; bound failures, errors and actual closure facts remain separate.
